item.title: Japanese Yen remains depressed as USD strengthens on rising geopolitical tensions
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) drifts lower against a broadly firmer US Dollar (USD) for the fourth straight day, pushing the USD/JPY pair to a nearly two-week top, around the 157.30 region, during the Asian session on Monday.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD may find the primary barrier at the nine-day EMA
item.description: GBP/USD extends its losses for the second successive session, trading around 1.3420 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: AUD/JPY rises to near 105.00 as fiscal concerns weigh on Yen
item.description: AUD/JPY remains in the positive territory, trading around 104.90 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross remains stronger as the Japanese Yen (JPY) faces pressure amid fiscal concerns over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s large-scale spending plans to spur growth.

item.title: WTI falls to near $57 as US pledges to build Venezuela Oil infrastructure
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trades 0.4% lower to near $57.00 in the late Asian trade on Monday.

item.title: Gold stands firm above $4,400 as geopolitical risks boost safe-haven demand
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to strong intraday gains above the $4,400 mark through the Asian session on Monday and seems poised to climb further amid the global flight to safety.

item.title: USD/INR jumps to two-week high on Trump’s tariff threats, geopolitical risks
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) slides to a fresh almost two-week low against the US Dollar (USD) at the open on Monday.

item.title: NZD/USD loses ground to near 0.5750 on Venezuela raid, geopolitical risks
item.description: The NZD/USD pair attracts some sellers to around 0.5755 during the early European session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) on the global flight to safety, bolstered by rising geopolitical tensions.
